🫏 New post ready 📖 Story · adult life · 8 slides “we spent two years sharing a kitchen and only spoke through sticky notes on the fridge.” 📝 Slides
1. we spent two years sharing a kitchen and only spoke through sticky notes on the fridge. 2. we'd see each other across the counter, but the words stayed in our heads. 3. we just watched tv in the dark, our feet on opposite ends of the same cheap sofa. 4. then the lease ended, we packed our boxes, and we went our separate ways with a quick wave. 5. yesterday we ran into each other by the fruit stand, both holding the same cheap grocery bags we used to stack under the sink. 6. we stood there, ready for the brief hello and quick walk away we always did, when you stopped. 7. you looked at me and said, i really missed you. 8. some people leave a mark on your life without ever making a sound.
✍️ Caption
sometimes the quietest years are the ones that stick to you the most. i hope you are doing well, wherever you are living now. send this to an old roommate. #roommates #oldfriends #movingout #apartments
